settings.heading: Financing Info
settings.subtext: Owner financing with no bank approval, no credit check, and no waiting.

settings.intro: With owner financing, we are the bank. You make a small down payment to reserve your land, then pay affordable monthly installments until it's paid off. There's no bank approval, no credit check, and no waiting period — it's that simple.

settings.yes_items:
Low down payments starting at $249
Monthly payments as low as $89/month
No bank approval or waiting period
Flexible terms to fit your budget
Early payoff allowed at any time
settings.no_items:
Credit score of 680+ typically required
Down payments of 20–30% common
Bank approval can take weeks or months
Closing costs add thousands to the price
Strict income verification required
Many vacant land loans simply aren't available
